description.html: This 36x28x35 cm aquarium (35.3 L) offers enough room for a layout with live plants, roots and stone. The glass is precisely cut and bonded with aquarium silicone, which makes it fully watertight.

The volume suits a variety of freshwater communities, from guppies and mollies to tetras, corydoras and smaller gourami species. An aquascape with live plants and a natural substrate of quartz sand or gravel completes the look.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
